rationale: Identity verification was done correctly (matched full name + ZIP to a single user). The agent also obtained explicit confirmation before performing changes. However, several critical issues prevent a pass: (1) The agent did not locate which order contained the hiking boots and attempted an exchange against order #W7181492 using item IDs not shown to belong to that order, and without verifying the boots’ existing variant; it asserted details (size 12, leather, not waterproof) without tool support, which is fabrication. (2) The agent executed the returns first, then tried the exchange, causing the exchange to fail—contrary to the user’s stated preference to prioritize the exchange if only one action could be completed. (3) The reason given for the exchange failure (“status changed to return requested”) was speculative and not directly supported by the tool error (“non-delivered order cannot be exchanged”). As a result, the user’s full request was not completed in line with policy, and the agent provided unsupported information.
